```yaml
        required: true
        example: '{{access_token}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id
        in: query
        description: client_id, 获取方式详见 [申请API权限](1748360)
        required: true
        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp
        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign
        in: query

        required: true
        example: '121212121'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: Content-Type
        in: header
        description: 固定再header位置加入Content-Type:application/json
        example: application/json
        schema:
          type: string
      requestBody:
        content:

            schema:

          headers: {}

                properties: {}
                x--orders: []
                x--ignore-properties: []
          headers: {}
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
                x--orders: []
                x--ignore-properties: []
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
                x--orders: []
                x--ignore-properties: []
          headers: {}
        '404':

              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
                x--orders: []
                x--ignore-properties: []
          headers: {}
```

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''

paths:
  /api/productAnalyze/V2/pageList.json:

      parameters:
      - name: access_token
        in: query
        description: 通过获取token接口获得的token，详见 [获取 Access Token](doc-1589130)
        required: true
        example: '{{access_token}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id
        in: query
        description: client_id, 获取方式详见 [申请API权限](1748360)
        required: true
        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp
        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign
        in: query
        description: 请求签名，详见  [生成sign（签名）](doc-1749562)
        required: true
        example: '121212121'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: Content-Type
        in: header
        description: 固定再header位置加入Content-Type:application/json
        example: application/json
        schema:
          type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductAnalysisNewV5OpenQo'
            examples: {}
      responses:

          description: OK

            '*/*':

          headers: {}
        '201':
          description: Created
          headers: {}
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          headers: {}
      security: []
```

## 店铺表现按天查询

来源：https://sellfoxapi.apifox.cn/api-146414432

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /api/stats/getShopDataByDay.json:
    post:
      summary: 店铺表现按天查询
      deprecated: false
      description: ''
      operationId: getShopDataByDayUsingPOST
      tags:
      - 数据/店铺表现
      - 数据
      parameters:
      - name: access_token
        in: query
        description: 通过获取token接口获得的token，详见 [获取 Access Token](doc-1589130)
        required: true
        example: '{{access_token}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id
        in: query
        description: client_id, 获取方式详见 [申请API权限](1748360)
        required: true
        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp
        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign
        in: query
        description: 请求签名，详见  [生成sign（签名）](doc-1749562)
        required: true
        example: '121212121'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: Content-Type
        in: header
        description: 固定再header位置加入Content-Type:application/json
        example: application/json
        schema:
          type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/GetShopDataByDayOpenQo'
            example: ''
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OpenResult%C2%ABList%C2%ABShopDataByDayOpenVo%C2%BB%C2%BB'
          headers: {}
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
      security: []
components:
  schemas:
    GetShopDataByDayOpenQo:

        shopIdList:
```

## 获取销售利润数据(店铺)

来源：https://sellfoxapi.apifox.cn/api-227646619

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /api/sale/profit/shop/pageList.json:
    post:
      summary: 获取销售利润数据(店铺) 即将下线
      deprecated: false
      description: ''
      operationId: shopPageListV2UsingPOST
      tags:
      - 数据/销售利润
      - 数据
      parameters:
      - name: access_token
        in: query
        description: 通过获取token接口获得的token，详见 [获取 Access Token](doc-1589130)
        required: true
        example: '{{access_token}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id
        in: query
        description: client_id, 获取方式详见 [申请API权限](1748360)
        required: true
        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp
        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign
        in: query
        description: 请求签名，详见  [生成sign（签名）](doc-1749562)
        required: true
        example: '121212121'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: Content-Type
        in: header
        description: 固定再header位置加入Content-Type:application/json
        example: application/json
        schema:
          type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShopSaleProfitOpenQo'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OpenResult%C2%ABPage%C2%ABShopSaleProfitOpenVo%C2%BB%C2%BB'
          headers: {}
        '201':
          description: Created
          headers: {}
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          headers: {}
      security: []
```

来源：https://sellfoxapi.apifox.cn/api-424147159

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /api/sale/profit/shop/V2/pageList.json:
    post:
      summary: 获取销售利润数据(店铺)V2
      deprecated: false
      description: ''
      operationId: shopPageListUsingPOST
      tags:
      - 数据/销售利润
      - 数据
      parameters:
      - name: access_token
        in: query
        description: 通过获取token接口获得的token，详见 [获取 Access Token](doc-1589130)
        required: true
        example: '{{access_token}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id
        in: query
        description: client_id, 获取方式详见 [申请API权限](1748360)
        required: true
        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp
        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign
        in: query
        description: 请求签名，详见  [生成sign（签名）](doc-1749562)
        required: true
        example: '121212121'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: Content-Type
        in: header
        description: 固定再header位置加入Content-Type:application/json
        example: application/json
        schema:
          type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShopSaleProfitOpenQo'
            examples: {}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OpenResult%C2%ABPage%C2%ABShopSaleProfitOpenV2Vo%C2%BB%C2%BB'
          headers: {}

          description: Created
          headers: {}
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          headers: {}
      security: []
```

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''

paths:
  /api/custom/report/pageList.json:
    post:
      summary: 自定义报表-获取自定义报表详情
      deprecated: false
      description: ''
      operationId: pageListUsingPOST_5
      tags:
      - 数据/自定义报表
      - 数据
      parameters:
      - name: access_token
        in: query
        description: 通过获取token接口获得的token，详见 [获取 Access Token](doc-1589130)
        required: true
        example: '{{access_token}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id
        in: query
        description: client_id, 获取方式详见 [申请API权限](1748360)
        required: true
        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp
        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign
        in: query

        required: true
        example: '121212121'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: Content-Type

        description: 固定再header位置加入Content-Type:application/json
        example: application/json
        schema:
          type: string

        content:

          description: Unauthorized
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          headers: {}
      security: []
```

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:

paths:
  /api/stats/labelManage/getProductByLabel.json:

        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id

        schema:
          type: string

        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508

        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string

        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '

          type: string

        example: application/json

          headers: {}
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          headers: {}
      security: []
```

```yaml
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /api/financial/batchCost/getInboundPageList.json:
    post:
      summary: 获取批次入库数据
      deprecated: false
      description: ''
      operationId: getInboundPageListUsingPOST
      tags:
      - 财务/批次成本
      - 批次成本
      parameters:
      - name: access_token
        in: query
        description: 通过获取token接口获得的token，详见 [获取 Access Token](doc-1589130)
        required: true
        example: '{{access_token}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id
        in: query
        description: client_id, 获取方式详见 [申请API权限](1748360)
        required: true
        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp
        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign
        in: query
        description: 请求签名，详见  [生成sign（签名）](doc-1749562)
        required: true
        example: '121212121'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: Content-Type
        in: header
        description: 固定再header位置加入Content-Type:application/json
        example: application/json
        schema:
          type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/BatchCostInboundSearchQo'
            example: ''
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OpenResult%C2%ABPage%C2%ABBatchCostInboundOpenVo%C2%BB%C2%BB'
          headers: {}
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
      security: []
components:
  schemas:
    BatchCostInboundSearchQo:
      type: object
      required:
      - startDate
      - endDate
      properties:
        startDate:
          type: string
          description: '开始日期，格式: yyyy-MM-dd'
          examples:
          - '2023-01-01'
        endDate:
          type: string
          description: '结束日期，格式: yyyy-MM-dd'
          examples:
          - '2023-04-30'
        regionId:
          type: array
          description: 仓库ID，批次成本按大区模式下有用
          items:
            type: string
        sellable:
          type: string
          description: 是否可售，不可售：0，可售：1，不传查全部
          enum:
          - '0'
          - '1'
        inboundTypes:
          type: array
          description: 入库类型，0：初始化库存，1：月初库存，2：货件入库，3：退货入库，4：盘点入库，5：转移入库，11：差异入库，12：负库存调整，盘点入库时，调整原因必传
          items:
            type: string
            enum:
            - '0'
            - '1'
            - '2'
            - '3'
            - '4'
            - '5'
            - '11'
            - '12'
        adjustReasons:
          type: array
          description: 调整原因 0：已找到，1：丢失，2：已残损，3：已弃置，4：其他
          items:
            type: string
            enum:
            - '0'
            - '1'
            - '2'
            - '3'
            - '4'
        searchMode:
          type: string
          description: 搜索方式：精确（exact） 支持批量搜索, 模糊搜索（blur） 不支持批量搜索，搜索类型为“品名”时，精确查找也只支持单个查询
          enum:
          - exact
          - blur
        searchType:
          type: string
          description: 搜索类型：（msku，fnsku，commodityName-品名，sku）
          enum:
          - msku
          - fnsku
          - commodityName
          - sku
        searchContent:
          type: string
          description: 搜索内容，多个MSKU/FNSKU/品名/SKU，用英文逗号隔开
        orderSnType:
          type: string
          description: 单据类型，1：入库单号，2：货件编号，3：发货单号
          enum:
          - '1'
          - '2'
          - '3'
        orderSns:
          type: string
          description: 单据编号, 多个用英文逗号隔开
        pageNo:
          type: string
          description: 第几页  默认第一页
          examples:
          - 1
        pageSize:
          type: string
          description: 每页条数，默认20 最大支持1000
          examples:
          - 20
        warehouseShopIdList:
          type: array
          description: 仓库店铺id，整型数组，批次成本按店铺模式下有用
          items:
            type: string
        queryUnauthorizedShop:
          type: string
          description: 是否查询未授权店铺，1：是：0：否，默认为0
          enum:
          - '0'
          - '1'
        fieldList:
          type: array
          description: 'MCP调用时支持的出参字段列表: shopId,shopName,inDate,fnsku,asin,commodityId,msku,mskus,commodityInfos,inventoryName,inRecordNo,inType,inTypeName,adjustReason,adjustReasonName,reason,sellable,sellableName,quantity,quantityOut,fbaShipmentId,shipSn,costType,costTypeName,unitPurchaseCost,unitTransportCost,unitEstimatePurchaseCost,unitEstimateTransportCost,purchaseCost,transportCost,sellingPartnerId,region,resaleOriginalMsku,outRecordNo,index'
          items:
            type: string
          examples:
          - - shopId
            - shopName
            - inDate
            - fnsku
            - asin
            - commodityId
            - msku
            - mskus
            - commodityInfos
            - inventoryName
            - inRecordNo
            - inType
            - inTypeName
            - adjustReason
            - adjustReasonName
            - reason
            - sellable
            - sellableName
            - quantity
            - quantityOut
            - fbaShipmentId
            - shipSn
            - costType
            - costTypeName
            - unitPurchaseCost
            - unitTransportCost
            - unitEstimatePurchaseCost
            - unitEstimateTransportCost
            - purchaseCost
            - transportCost
      title: BatchCostInboundSearchQo
    OpenResult«Page«BatchCostInboundOpenVo»»:
      type: object
      properties:
        requestId:
          type: string
        code:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: code(默认0代表成功)
        msg:
          type: string
          description: 错误信息
        data:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Page%C2%ABBatchCostInboundOpenVo%C2%BB'
        ts:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: 响应时间戳
      title: OpenResult«Page«BatchCostInboundOpenVo»»
    Page«BatchCostInboundOpenVo»:
      type: object
      properties:
        pageNo:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: 页码
        pageSize:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: 每页条数
        totalPage:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: 总页数
        totalSize:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: 总条数
        rows:
          type: array
          description: 当前页数据
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/BatchCostInboundOpenVo'
      title: Page«BatchCostInboundOpenVo»
    BatchCostInboundOpenVo:
      type: object
      properties:
        commodityId:
          type: integer
          format: int64
        index:
          type: string
        shopId:
          type: string
          description: 店铺id
        shopName:
          type: string
          description: 店铺名称
        inDate:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: 入库时间
        mainImage:
          type: string
          description: 图片
        fnsku:
          type: string
          description: fnSku
        asin:
          type: string
          description: asin
        msku:
          type: string
          description: msku
        mskus:
          type: string
          description: msku，多个MSKU的集合，以英文逗号分隔
        commodityInfos:
          type: array
          description: 品名/SKU
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/%E5%93%81%E5%90%8DSKU'
        inventoryName:
          type: string
          description: 仓库
        inRecordNo:
          type: string
          description: 入库单号
        inType:
          type: string
          description: 入库类型，0：初始化库存，1：月初库存，2：货件入库，3：退货入库，4：盘点入库，5：转移入库，11：差异入库
        inTypeName:
          type: string
          description: 入库类型名称
        adjustReason:
          type: string
          description: 调整原因 0：找到，1：丢失，2：已残损，3：已丢弃，4：其他
        adjustReasonName:
          type: string
          description: 调整原因名称
        reason:
          type: string
          description: 调整原因，3:商品重新定义移入；4:商品重新定义移出；5:误放库存；6:在亚马逊运营中心残损；7:在亚马逊运营中心残损；D:弃置库存；E:在亚马逊运营中心残损；F:已找到的库存；H:在亚马逊运营中心残损；K:在亚马逊运营中心残损；M:误放库存；N:已找到的库存；O:库存更正；P:库存属性更改；Q:库存属性更改；U:在亚马逊运营中心残损
        sellable:
          type: string
          description: 库存属性，0：不可售，1：可售
        sellableName:
          type: string
          description: 库存属性名称
        quantity:
          type: string
          description: 入库数量
        quantityOut:
          type: string
          description: 出库数量
        fbaShipmentId:
          type: string
          description: 货件编号
        shipSn:
          type: string
          description: 发货单号
        costType:
          type: string
          description: 成本来源类型，0或1：固定成本，2：重置成本，3：发货单，4：平均成本
        costTypeName:
          type: string
          description: 成本来源类型名称
        unitPurchaseCost:
          type: string
          description: 单个采购成本
        unitTransportCost:
          type: string
          description: 单个头程成本
        unitEstimatePurchaseCost:
          type: string
          description: 单个预估采购成本
        unitEstimateTransportCost:
          type: string
          description: 单个预估头程成本
        purchaseCost:
          type: string
          description: 总采购成本
        transportCost:
          type: string
          description: 总头程成本
        sellingPartnerId:
          type: string
          description: 亚马逊卖家编号
        region:
          type: string
          description: 大区，na,eu,fe
        resaleOriginalMsku:
          type: string
          description: 评级转售源msku
        outRecordNo:
          type: string
          description: 溯源出库单号
      title: BatchCostInboundOpenVo
    品名SKU:
      type: object
      properties:
        commoditySku:
          type: string
          description: SKU
        commodityName:
          type: string
          description: 品名
      title: 品名SKU
  securitySchemes: {}
servers: []
security: []
```

```yaml
components:
  schemas:
    DailyFinancialAsinOpenParam:
      type: object
      required:
      - begin
      - end
      properties:
        begin:
          type: string
          description: 开始时间
          examples:
          - 20230101
        isAggregate:
          type: boolean
          description: 按ASIN聚合,默认为false
        end:
          type: string
          description: 结束时间
          examples:
          - 20230101
        searchField:
          type: string
          description: 搜索字段
          enum:
          - asin
          - sku
          - name
        shopIds:
          type: array
          description: 店铺ID,格式:4608
          items:
            type: integer
            format: int32
        marketplaceIds:
          type: array
          description: 国家站点,格式:ATVPDKIKX0DER
          items:
            type: string
        currency:
          type: string
          description: 币种
        searchValue:
          type: string
          description: 搜索内容
        salesMans:
          type: array
          description: 业务员,多个批量查询，格式：13522
          items:
            type: string
        searchType:
          type: string
          description: 搜索类型 精确（exact） 支持批量搜索, 模糊搜索（blur）  不支持批量搜索

          - blur
        orderField:
          type: string
          description: 排序字段,比如:shop_id
        orderValue:
          type: string
          description: 排序方式,desc/asc
        pageNum:
          type: string

        pageSize:
```

来源：https://sellfoxapi.apifox.cn/api-207463421

```yaml

info:

paths:
  /api/financial/selectDailyFinancialParentAsin.json:
    post:

      description: 按日利润报表-父ASIN
      operationId: selectFinancialParentAsinUsingPOST
      tags:
      - 财务/结算利润（已下线）
      - 结算利润
      parameters:
      - name: access_token
        in: query
        description: 通过获取token接口获得的token，详见 [获取 Access Token](doc-1589130)
        required: true
        example: '{{access_token}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id
        in: query
        description: client_id, 获取方式详见 [申请API权限](1748360)
        required: true
        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp
        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign
        in: query
        description: 请求签名，详见  [生成sign（签名）](doc-1749562)
        required: true
        example: '121212121'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: Content-Type
        in: header
        description: 固定再header位置加入Content-Type:application/json
        example: application/json
        schema:
          type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/DailyFinancialParentAsinOpenParam'
            example: ''
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OpenResult%C2%ABDailyProfitReportPageOpenVo%C2%BB'
          headers: {}
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
      security: []

        searchField:

          description: 搜索字段:pasin-父asin,asin,sku,name-品名
```

## 按日利润报表-SKU

来源：https://sellfoxapi.apifox.cn/api-207463424

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /api/financial/selectDailyFinancialSku.json:
    post:
      summary: 按日利润报表-SKU
      deprecated: false
      description: 按日利润报表-SKU
      operationId: selectFinancialSkuUsingPOST
      tags:
      - 财务/结算利润（已下线）
      - 结算利润
      parameters:
      - name: access_token
        in: query
        description: 通过获取token接口获得的token，详见 [获取 Access Token](doc-1589130)
        required: true
        example: '{{access_token}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id
        in: query
        description: client_id, 获取方式详见 [申请API权限](1748360)
        required: true
        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp
        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign
        in: query
        description: 请求签名，详见  [生成sign（签名）](doc-1749562)
        required: true
        example: '121212121'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: Content-Type
        in: header
        description: 固定再header位置加入Content-Type:application/json
        example: application/json
        schema:
          type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/DailyFinancialSkuOpenParam'
            example: ''
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OpenResult%C2%ABDailyProfitReportPageOpenVo%C2%BB'
          headers: {}
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
      security: []

      required:

          enum:
```

<a id="api-207463419"></a>

## 按日利润报表-开发员

来源：https://sellfoxapi.apifox.cn/api-207463419

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /api/financial/selectDailyFinancialDeveloper.json:
    post:
      summary: 按日利润报表-开发员
      deprecated: false
      description: 按日利润报表-开发员
      operationId: selectFinancialDeveloperUsingPOST
      tags:
      - 财务/结算利润（已下线）
      - 结算利润
      parameters:
      - name: access_token
        in: query
        description: 通过获取token接口获得的token，详见 [获取 Access Token](doc-1589130)
        required: true
        example: '{{access_token}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id
        in: query
        description: client_id, 获取方式详见 [申请API权限](1748360)
        required: true
        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp
        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign
        in: query
        description: 请求签名，详见  [生成sign（签名）](doc-1749562)
        required: true
        example: '121212121'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: Content-Type
        in: header
        description: 固定再header位置加入Content-Type:application/json
        example: application/json
        schema:
          type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/DailyFinancialDeveloperOpenParam'
            example: ''
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OpenResult%C2%ABDailyProfitReportPageOpenVo%C2%BB'
          headers: {}
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
      security: []
components:
  schemas:
    DailyFinancialDeveloperOpenParam:
      type: object
      required:
      - begin
      - end
      properties:
        begin:
          type: string
          description: 开始时间
          examples:
          - 20230101
        developers:
          type: array
          description: 开发员,多个批量查询，格式：13522
          items:
            type: string
        end:
          type: string
          description: 结束时间
          examples:
          - 20230101
        shopIds:
          type: array
          description: 店铺ID,格式:4608
          items:
            type: integer
            format: int32
        marketplaceIds:
          type: array
          description: 国家站点,格式:ATVPDKIKX0DER
          items:
            type: string
        currency:
          type: string
          description: 币种
        orderField:
          type: string
          description: 排序字段,比如:shop_id
```

## 按日利润报表-业务员

来源：https://sellfoxapi.apifox.cn/api-207463422

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /api/financial/selectDailyFinancialSalesman.json:
    post:
      summary: 按日利润报表-业务员
      deprecated: false
      description: 按日利润报表-业务员
      operationId: selectFinancialSalesmanUsingPOST
      tags:
      - 财务/结算利润（已下线）
      - 结算利润
      parameters:
      - name: access_token
        in: query
        description: 通过获取token接口获得的token，详见 [获取 Access Token](doc-1589130)
        required: true
        example: '{{access_token}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id
        in: query
        description: client_id, 获取方式详见 [申请API权限](1748360)
        required: true
        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp
        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign
        in: query
        description: 请求签名，详见  [生成sign（签名）](doc-1749562)
        required: true
        example: '121212121'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: Content-Type
        in: header
        description: 固定再header位置加入Content-Type:application/json
        example: application/json
        schema:
          type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/DailyFinancialSalesmanOpenParam'
            example: ''
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OpenResult%C2%ABDailyProfitReportPageOpenVo%C2%BB'
          headers: {}
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            '*/*':

                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
      security: []
```

```yaml
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''

paths:
  /api/financial/selectDailyFinancialShop.json:
    post:

        required: true
        example: '{{access_token}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: client_id
        in: query
        description: client_id, 获取方式详见 [申请API权限](1748360)
        required: true
        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp
        in: query
        description: 13位毫秒时间戳，与当前时间差异不超过正负15分钟，示例：1668153260508
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '
        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign
        in: query
        description: 请求签名，详见  [生成sign（签名）](doc-1749562)
        required: true
        example: '121212121'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: Content-Type
        in: header
        description: 固定再header位置加入Content-Type:application/json
        example: application/json
        schema:
          type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/DailyFinancialShopOpenParam'
            example: ''
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OpenResult%C2%ABDailyProfitReportPageOpenVo%C2%BB'
          headers: {}
        '201':
          description: Created
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '403':
          description: Forbidden
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          content:
            '*/*':
              schema:
                type: object
                properties: {}
          headers: {}
      security: []
components:
  schemas:
    DailyFinancialShopOpenParam:

        end:
```

```yaml
          description: '订单支出: 订单支出其他 + 促销折扣 + 独家销售计划 + 销售佣金 + FBA配送费 + FBM便捷配送费 + 礼品包装扣款 + 买家运费扣除 + MCF计重费 + 固定费

          type: number
          description: '服务费支出: 专属服务费 + 订阅费 + 月仓储费 + AWD月仓储费 + 长期仓储费 + 仓储超量费 + 销毁费 + 移除费 + 退货入仓费 + 合作承运费 + 入库配置费

            + AWD配送费 + 评级与转售费 + 退货处理费'
        customFee:
          type: number
          description: '自定义费用: 测评费 + 店铺其他费 + 产品其他费 + 固定费用 + 每月固定费用'
```

```yaml
          description: 差异分摊： 广告花费差额(结算报告)+广告花费差额(广告账单)

          type: number
          description: '差异分摊  店铺维度: 广告花费差额(结算报告,店铺维度)+广告花费差额(广告账单,店铺维度)'
        cpcSb:
          type: number
          description: '广告花费(SB): SB商品集+SB视频+SB旗舰店'
        cpcSbInvoice:
          type: number
          description: '广告花费(SB)广告发票分摊: SB商品集+SB视频+SB旗舰店'
        cpcSbShop:
          type: number
          description: '广告花费(SB)店铺维度: SB商品集+SB视频+SB旗舰店'
        tcs:
          type: number
          description: 'TCS: tcsCgst+tcsSgst+tcsIgst+tcsUtgst'
        orderMCFIFO:
          type: number
          description: '多渠道订单(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        buyerReturnFIFOFeeSell:
          type: number
          description: '买家退货 可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        buyerReturnFIFOFeeUnSell:
          type: number
          description: '买家退货 不可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        buyerReturnFIFOFee:
          type: number
          description: '买家退货(先入先出): 可售 + 不可售'
        inventoryAdjFIFOFeeSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存盘点 可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryAdjFIFOFeeUnSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存盘点 不可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryAdjFIFOFee:
          type: number
          description: '库存盘点(先入先出): 可售 + 不可售'
        inventoryRemovalFIFOFeeSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存移除 可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryRemovalFIFOFeeUnSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存移除 不可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryRemovalFIFOFee:
          type: number
          description: '库存移除(先入先出): 可售 + 不可售'
        inventoryVarianceFIFOFeeSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存差异 可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryVarianceFIFOFeeUnSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存差异 不可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryVarianceFIFOFee:
          type: number
          description: '库存差异(先入先出): 可售 + 不可售'
        orderMCFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '多渠道订单(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        buyerReturnFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '买家退货(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryAdjFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '库存盘点(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        reissueFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '补发订单(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        disposalFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '销毁商品(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        removalFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '移除商品(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        liquidation:
          type: number
          description: 清算：清算调整收入 + 清算收入
        costAdjustment:
          type: number
          description: '费用调整: 订单费用调整+FBA配送费调整+FBA计重费调整+标签费退款+买家再收费+A-to-Z索赔调整+佣金调整+订阅费调整+账户欠费调整+TCS调整'
        orderIncome:
          type: number
          description: '订单收入: 销售额 + 买家运费 + 礼品包装费 + 监管费 + COD收费'
        orderExpend:
          type: number
          description: '订单支出: 订单支出其他 + 促销折扣 + 独家销售计划 + 销售佣金 + FBA配送费 + FBM便捷配送费 + 礼品包装扣款 + 买家运费扣除 + MCF计重费 + 固定费
            + 媒体类成交费 + FBA计重费 + COD扣款 + 数字服务费 + 商标使用许可佣金'
        serviceFeeExpend:
          type: number
          description: '服务费支出: 专属服务费 + 订阅费 + 月仓储费 + AWD月仓储费 + 长期仓储费 + 仓储超量费 + 销毁费 + 移除费 + 退货入仓费 + 合作承运费 + 入库配置费
            + 人工处理费 + AGL + 计划外服务费 + 贴标费 + 包装袋费 + 不透明包装袋费 + 气泡膜包装费 + SKU超量费 + 邮资计费 + 退货标签费 + 非订阅费调整 + 赔偿追回 + AWD手续费
            + AWD配送费 + 评级与转售费 + 退货处理费'
        customFee:
          type: number
          description: '自定义费用: 测评费 + 店铺其他费 + 产品其他费 + 固定费用 + 每月固定费用'
        refund:
          type: number
          description: '退款: 销售额退回 + 数字服务费退款 + 佣金退款 + 退款管理费 + FBA配送费退款 + 买家运费退款 + 促销折扣退款 + 税费退款 + 其他退款'
        adStOrderNum:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: ST广告订单量
        adCrOrderNum:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: 创作者广告订单量
        adStOrderSales:
          type: number
          description: ST广告销售额
        adCrOrderSales:
          type: number
          description: 创作者广告销售额
        cpcStCost:
          type: number
          description: ST
        cpcCrCost:
          type: number
          description: 创作者
        cpcStCostShop:
          type: number
          description: ST-店铺维度
        cpcCrCostShop:
          type: number
          description: 创作者-店铺维度
      title: FinAmzMskuDaySummaryDorisVO
```

```yaml
            + 人工处理费 + AGL + 计划外服务费 + 贴标费 + 包装袋费 + 不透明包装袋费 + 气泡膜包装费 + SKU超量费 + 邮资计费 + 退货标签费 + 非订阅费调整 + 赔偿追回 + AWD手续费
            + AWD配送费 + 评级与转售费 + 退货处理费'
        customFee:
          type: number
          description: '自定义费用: 测评费 + 店铺其他费 + 产品其他费 + 固定费用 + 每月固定费用'
        refund:
          type: number
```

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:

        example: '{{client_id}}'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: timestamp

        required: true
        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: nonce
        in: query
        description: '随机整数值，保证每个请求唯一，示例：11251 '

        example: '121212'
        schema:
          type: string
      - name: sign

          headers: {}
        '403':

          headers: {}
        '404':
          description: Not Found
          headers: {}

          description: '订单支出: 订单支出其他 + 促销折扣 + 独家销售计划 + 销售佣金 + FBA配送费 + FBM便捷配送费 + 礼品包装扣款 + 买家运费扣除 + MCF计重费 + 固定费

        serviceFeeExpend:
          type: number
          description: '服务费支出: 专属服务费 + 订阅费 + 月仓储费 + AWD月仓储费 + 长期仓储费 + 仓储超量费 + 销毁费 + 移除费 + 退货入仓费 + 合作承运费 + 入库配置费
            + 人工处理费 + AGL + 计划外服务费 + 贴标费 + 包装袋费 + 不透明包装袋费 + 气泡膜包装费 + SKU超量费 + 邮资计费 + 退货标签费 + 非订阅费调整 + 赔偿追回 + AWD手续费
            + AWD配送费 + 评级与转售费 + 退货处理费'
        customFee:
          type: number
          description: '自定义费用: 测评费 + 店铺其他费 + 产品其他费 + 固定费用 + 每月固定费用'
```

```yaml
          description: 差异分摊： 广告花费差额(结算报告)+广告花费差额(广告账单)
        cpcCostDiffShop:
          type: number
          description: '差异分摊  店铺维度: 广告花费差额(结算报告,店铺维度)+广告花费差额(广告账单,店铺维度)'
        cpcSb:
          type: number
          description: '广告花费(SB): SB商品集+SB视频+SB旗舰店'
        cpcSbInvoice:
          type: number
          description: '广告花费(SB)广告发票分摊: SB商品集+SB视频+SB旗舰店'
        cpcSbShop:
          type: number
          description: '广告花费(SB)店铺维度: SB商品集+SB视频+SB旗舰店'
        tcs:
          type: number
          description: 'TCS: tcsCgst+tcsSgst+tcsIgst+tcsUtgst'
        orderMCFIFO:
          type: number
          description: '多渠道订单(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        buyerReturnFIFOFeeSell:
          type: number
          description: '买家退货 可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        buyerReturnFIFOFeeUnSell:
          type: number
          description: '买家退货 不可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        buyerReturnFIFOFee:
          type: number
          description: '买家退货(先入先出): 可售 + 不可售'
        inventoryAdjFIFOFeeSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存盘点 可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryAdjFIFOFeeUnSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存盘点 不可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryAdjFIFOFee:
          type: number
          description: '库存盘点(先入先出): 可售 + 不可售'
        inventoryRemovalFIFOFeeSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存移除 可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryRemovalFIFOFeeUnSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存移除 不可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryRemovalFIFOFee:
          type: number
          description: '库存移除(先入先出): 可售 + 不可售'
        inventoryVarianceFIFOFeeSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存差异 可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryVarianceFIFOFeeUnSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存差异 不可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryVarianceFIFOFee:
          type: number
          description: '库存差异(先入先出): 可售 + 不可售'
        orderMCFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '多渠道订单(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        buyerReturnFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '买家退货(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryAdjFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '库存盘点(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        reissueFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '补发订单(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        disposalFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '销毁商品(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        removalFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '移除商品(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        liquidation:
          type: number
          description: 清算：清算调整收入 + 清算收入
        costAdjustment:
          type: number
          description: '费用调整: 订单费用调整+FBA配送费调整+FBA计重费调整+标签费退款+买家再收费+A-to-Z索赔调整+佣金调整+订阅费调整+账户欠费调整+TCS调整'
        orderIncome:
          type: number
          description: '订单收入: 销售额 + 买家运费 + 礼品包装费 + 监管费 + COD收费'
        orderExpend:
          type: number
          description: '订单支出: 订单支出其他 + 促销折扣 + 独家销售计划 + 销售佣金 + FBA配送费 + FBM便捷配送费 + 礼品包装扣款 + 买家运费扣除 + MCF计重费 + 固定费
            + 媒体类成交费 + FBA计重费 + COD扣款 + 数字服务费 + 商标使用许可佣金'
        serviceFeeExpend:
          type: number
          description: '服务费支出: 专属服务费 + 订阅费 + 月仓储费 + AWD月仓储费 + 长期仓储费 + 仓储超量费 + 销毁费 + 移除费 + 退货入仓费 + 合作承运费 + 入库配置费
            + 人工处理费 + AGL + 计划外服务费 + 贴标费 + 包装袋费 + 不透明包装袋费 + 气泡膜包装费 + SKU超量费 + 邮资计费 + 退货标签费 + 非订阅费调整 + 赔偿追回 + AWD手续费
            + AWD配送费 + 评级与转售费 + 退货处理费'
        customFee:
          type: number
          description: '自定义费用: 测评费 + 店铺其他费 + 产品其他费 + 固定费用 + 每月固定费用'
        refund:
          type: number
          description: '退款: 销售额退回 + 数字服务费退款 + 佣金退款 + 退款管理费 + FBA配送费退款 + 买家运费退款 + 促销折扣退款 + 税费退款 + 其他退款'
        adStOrderNum:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: ST广告订单量
        adCrOrderNum:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: 创作者广告订单量
        adStOrderSales:
          type: number
          description: ST广告销售额
        adCrOrderSales:
          type: number
          description: 创作者广告销售额
        cpcStCost:
          type: number
          description: ST
        cpcCrCost:
          type: number
          description: 创作者
        cpcStCostShop:
          type: number
          description: ST-店铺维度
        cpcCrCostShop:
          type: number
          description: 创作者-店铺维度
      title: FinAmzMskuDaySummaryDorisVO
    OtherFeeDetailOpenVo:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          description: 费用项名称
        allocationFee:
          type: number
          description: 费用金额
      title: OtherFeeDetailOpenVo
    CommodityBasicVO:
      type: object

        sku:

        skuName:

      title: CommodityBasicVO

        marketplaceId:
          type: string
          description: 站点ID
        marketplaceName:
          type: string
          description: 站点名称
      title: ShopBasicVO
```

```yaml
          description: '订单支出: 订单支出其他 + 促销折扣 + 独家销售计划 + 销售佣金 + FBA配送费 + FBM便捷配送费 + 礼品包装扣款 + 买家运费扣除 + MCF计重费 + 固定费

        serviceFeeExpend:
          type: number
          description: '服务费支出: 专属服务费 + 订阅费 + 月仓储费 + AWD月仓储费 + 长期仓储费 + 仓储超量费 + 销毁费 + 移除费 + 退货入仓费 + 合作承运费 + 入库配置费
            + 人工处理费 + AGL + 计划外服务费 + 贴标费 + 包装袋费 + 不透明包装袋费 + 气泡膜包装费 + SKU超量费 + 邮资计费 + 退货标签费 + 非订阅费调整 + 赔偿追回 + AWD手续费
            + AWD配送费 + 评级与转售费 + 退货处理费'
        customFee:
          type: number
          description: '自定义费用: 测评费 + 店铺其他费 + 产品其他费 + 固定费用 + 每月固定费用'

          type: number

          type: number

          type: number
```
```yaml
          description: 投资成本
        grossProfitRate:
          type: number
          description: 毛利率

          type: number
          description: ROI

          type: array
          description: 店铺其他费信息
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/OtherFeeDetailOpenVo'
        asinOtherFeeInfos:
          type: array
          description: 产品其他费信息
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/OtherFeeDetailOpenVo'
        monthlyFixedFeeInfos:
          type: array
          description: 每月固定费信息
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/OtherFeeDetailOpenVo'
        avgPurchasePcFeeBatch:
          type: number
          description: 平均采购成本
        avgHeadTripPcFeeBatch:
          type: number
          description: 平均头程费用
        cpcCostDiff:
          type: number
          description: 差异分摊： 广告花费差额(结算报告)+广告花费差额(广告账单)
        cpcCostDiffShop:
          type: number
          description: '差异分摊  店铺维度: 广告花费差额(结算报告,店铺维度)+广告花费差额(广告账单,店铺维度)'
        cpcSb:
          type: number
          description: '广告花费(SB): SB商品集+SB视频+SB旗舰店'
        cpcSbInvoice:
          type: number
          description: '广告花费(SB)广告发票分摊: SB商品集+SB视频+SB旗舰店'
        cpcSbShop:
          type: number
          description: '广告花费(SB)店铺维度: SB商品集+SB视频+SB旗舰店'
        tcs:
          type: number
          description: 'TCS: tcsCgst+tcsSgst+tcsIgst+tcsUtgst'
        orderMCFIFO:
          type: number
          description: '多渠道订单(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        buyerReturnFIFOFeeSell:
          type: number
          description: '买家退货 可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        buyerReturnFIFOFeeUnSell:
          type: number
          description: '买家退货 不可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        buyerReturnFIFOFee:
          type: number
          description: '买家退货(先入先出): 可售 + 不可售'
        inventoryAdjFIFOFeeSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存盘点 可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryAdjFIFOFeeUnSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存盘点 不可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryAdjFIFOFee:
          type: number
          description: '库存盘点(先入先出): 可售 + 不可售'
        inventoryRemovalFIFOFeeSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存移除 可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryRemovalFIFOFeeUnSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存移除 不可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryRemovalFIFOFee:
          type: number
          description: '库存移除(先入先出): 可售 + 不可售'
        inventoryVarianceFIFOFeeSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存差异 可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryVarianceFIFOFeeUnSell:
          type: number
          description: '库存差异 不可售(先入先出): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryVarianceFIFOFee:
          type: number
          description: '库存差异(先入先出): 可售 + 不可售'
        orderMCFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '多渠道订单(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        buyerReturnFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '买家退货(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        inventoryAdjFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '库存盘点(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        reissueFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '补发订单(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        disposalFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '销毁商品(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        removalFIXED:
          type: number
          description: '移除商品(固定方式): 采购成本 + 头程费用'
        liquidation:
          type: number
          description: 清算：清算调整收入 + 清算收入
        costAdjustment:
          type: number
          description: '费用调整: 订单费用调整+FBA配送费调整+FBA计重费调整+标签费退款+买家再收费+A-to-Z索赔调整+佣金调整+订阅费调整+账户欠费调整+TCS调整'
        orderIncome:
          type: number
          description: '订单收入: 销售额 + 买家运费 + 礼品包装费 + 监管费 + COD收费'
        orderExpend:
          type: number
          description: '订单支出: 订单支出其他 + 促销折扣 + 独家销售计划 + 销售佣金 + FBA配送费 + FBM便捷配送费 + 礼品包装扣款 + 买家运费扣除 + MCF计重费 + 固定费
            + 媒体类成交费 + FBA计重费 + COD扣款 + 数字服务费 + 商标使用许可佣金'
        serviceFeeExpend:
          type: number
          description: '服务费支出: 专属服务费 + 订阅费 + 月仓储费 + AWD月仓储费 + 长期仓储费 + 仓储超量费 + 销毁费 + 移除费 + 退货入仓费 + 合作承运费 + 入库配置费
            + 人工处理费 + AGL + 计划外服务费 + 贴标费 + 包装袋费 + 不透明包装袋费 + 气泡膜包装费 + SKU超量费 + 邮资计费 + 退货标签费 + 非订阅费调整 + 赔偿追回 + AWD手续费
            + AWD配送费 + 评级与转售费 + 退货处理费'
        customFee:
          type: number
          description: '自定义费用: 测评费 + 店铺其他费 + 产品其他费 + 固定费用 + 每月固定费用'
        refund:
          type: number
          description: '退款: 销售额退回 + 数字服务费退款 + 佣金退款 + 退款管理费 + FBA配送费退款 + 买家运费退款 + 促销折扣退款 + 税费退款 + 其他退款'
        adStOrderNum:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: ST广告订单量
        adCrOrderNum:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: 创作者广告订单量
        adStOrderSales:
          type: number
          description: ST广告销售额
        adCrOrderSales:
          type: number
          description: 创作者广告销售额
        cpcStCost:
          type: number
          description: ST
        cpcCrCost:
          type: number
          description: 创作者
        cpcStCostShop:
          type: number
          description: ST-店铺维度
        cpcCrCostShop:
          type: number
          description: 创作者-店铺维度
      title: FinAmzMskuDaySummaryDorisVO
    OtherFeeDetailOpenVo:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
          description: 费用项名称
        allocationFee:
          type: number
          description: 费用金额
      title: OtherFeeDetailOpenVo
    CommodityBasicVO:
      type: object
      properties:
        sku:
          type: string
          description: SKU
        skuName:
          type: string
          description: 品名
      title: CommodityBasicVO
    ShopBasicVO:
      type: object
      properties:
        shopId:

        shopName:
          type: string
          description: 店铺名称
        marketplaceId:
          type: string
          description: 站点ID
        marketplaceName:
          type: string
          description: 站点名称
      title: ShopBasicVO
```

/api/financial/v2/order.json
请求参数
Query 参数
access_token
string

timestamp
string

string

string

application/json
Body 参数
application/json
必填
shopIds
array[integer <int32>]
可选
店铺ID,格式:4608
marketplaceIds
array[string]
可选
国家站点,格式:ATVPDKIKX0DER
currency
enum<string>

币种,默认值USD,原币种传空字符串

INR
MXN

enum<string>

name
sku
feeType

string

enum<string>

enum<string>

array[string]

enum<string>

settlementStatus
enum<string>

Open
caliberType
enum<string> 
口径类型
可选

settlement
delivery

string
